headline: What the "5-week window" means and what comes next for Romania. Fiscal Council: "Taxes and duties will not rise in 2027"
summary: Romania's Fiscal Council stated that taxes and duties will not rise in 2027. Economist Daniel Dăianu emphasized that Romania needs a government with full powers amid a five-week window.
why: Fiscal policy and tax levels shape Romania's budget deficit, sovereign debt and the outlook for its bonds and currency.
